query: Push to prod - deploy master to staging and production.
expected_behavior: Runs the bundled scripts/git-pushtoprod.sh rather than improvising the promotion sequence
Promotes master by merging through staging first (this repo has a staging branch), then staging into production, rather than master straight to production
Applies the project rule that package*.json merge conflicts resolve with --ours and any other conflict aborts cleanly
Confirms with the user via AskUserQuestion before pushing to production rather than promoting unattended, and reports the resulting state
Never appends a Co-Authored-By line to any merge commit it creates
